title: Build daily signal aggregation job (daily windows + dedupe + backfills)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
## Context
We need a reliable daily aggregation job over usage + intent telemetry to compute the raw daily features used by the PLG Signal scoring service.

This ticket covers the *aggregation layer* (daily/weekly windows, idempotent writes, dedupe keys, and backfill support). Routing to HubSpot is handled separately (ENG-7750).

ADR reference:
- sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-usage-intent-signals-schema-v1.json

## Goals
- Produce one row per (org_id, workspace_id?, signal_type, window_start) per day with normalized counters/flags needed for scoring.
- Ensure deterministic dedupe keys to support re-runs + late-arriving events.
- Support backfills for a given date range without double-counting.
- Add unit tests for windowing, dedupe/idempotency, and late-arrival behavior.

## Non-goals
- Implement scoring logic / thresholds (owned by signal scoring service).
- Implement HubSpot routing / task creation.

## Inputs
Canonical event tables (as per telemetry contract v1; names may differ by environment):
- usage_events: tokens_in, tokens_out, request_count, spend_usd, model, route
- rate_limit_events: http_429_count, retry_after_ms (if present)
- reliability_events: timeout_count, p95_latency_ms (if present from edge logs)
- intent_events: docs_viewed (security/dedicated/private/pricing), pricing_clicks
- org_metadata snapshot (optional enrichment): plan_tier, region, created_at

## Output
Write daily aggregates into analytics dataset table:
- analytics.plg_signal_daily_agg (partitioned by window_date)

Minimum output columns (schema v1 alignment):
- window_start (YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z)
- window_end (YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z)
- window_granularity = DAY
- org_id
- workspace_id (nullable; if we only have org-level telemetry, set NULL)
- signal_type (enum-ish string; see ADR)
- dedupe_key (string; see below)
- counters (flattened columns): tokens_total, spend_usd, request_count, http_429_count, docs_security_faq_views, docs_dedicated_views, docs_private_views, pricing_page_views, workspace_invite_count (if available)
- data_freshness_ts (when the job wrote the row)
- source_max_event_ts (max event timestamp included)

## Dedupe / idempotency rules
- Primary dedupe key: sha256("org_id|workspace_id|signal_type|window_start")
- Job must be safe to re-run for the same date without creating duplicates.
- Use MERGE semantics on (org_id, workspace_id, signal_type, window_start) OR on dedupe_key.

## Late arrivals
- Daily job runs at ~03:00 UTC for the previous day.
- Recompute previous 3 days each run (rolling re-aggregation) to capture late events.
- Provide CLI args: --start-date, --end-date, --recompute-days (default 3)

## Backfill
- Must support backfill for pilot cohort analysis and to seed scoring history.
- Backfill should:
  - run with bounded concurrency
  - be observable (per-day success/failure)
  - write using same MERGE logic

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Daily aggregation job implemented with DAY windows, writing to analytics.plg_signal_daily_agg
- [x] Rolling recompute for last N days (default 3) supported
- [x] Backfill CLI / job parameters supported for arbitrary date ranges
- [x] Dedupe key implemented and verified (no duplicate rows when re-running)
- [x] Unit tests cover: window boundaries (UTC), null workspace_id behavior, rerun idempotency, late-arrival inclusion
- [x] Basic metrics emitted: rows_written, rows_merged, job_duration_seconds, max_event_lag_seconds

## Implementation notes
- Prefer a single query per day per signal_type (or a consolidated query with GROUP BY) to reduce warehouse load.
- Keep the aggregation output narrow and stable; do not encode business thresholds here.
- Coordinate with Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman on source table names and event timestamp semantics.

## Links
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/plg-to-sales-signal-routing-prd.json
- ADR schema v1: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-usage-intent-signals-schema-v1.json
- GitHub PR (event contract): sources/github/redwood/pr-28411-add-plg-signal-schema-and-event-contract.json
comments: 2025-04-18 — Talia Benson: Kicking this off for Phase 1. We need daily windows first; hourly is explicitly out-of-scope per privacy + noise concerns. Please align on dedupe key with ADR before coding.

2025-04-19 — Logan Wright: Confirmed: use UTC for all windows. Event timestamps are in UTC already; do *not* convert based on org region. Also: prefer MERGE on dedupe_key to avoid multi-column join bugs when workspace_id is NULL.

2025-04-22 — Mei Lin: Drafted aggregation SQL. One open question: do we emit separate rows per signal_type or a single row with all counters? I’m leaning per signal_type to match scoring inputs and keep merges smaller (and to align with dedupe_key definition).
2025-04-22 — Nikhil Sharma: +1 per signal_type. It keeps downstream scoring simpler and avoids confusion about which counters matter for which signal.

2025-04-24 — Caleb Johnson: Heads up: docs_view events can arrive ~24–48h late due to batch export from the docs provider. Recompute last 3 days seems fine; for backfills, make sure it’s easy to rerun a larger range.

2025-04-28 — Mei Lin: Implemented rolling recompute with default 3 days and added --start-date/--end-date flags. MERGE uses dedupe_key = sha256(org_id|coalesce(workspace_id,'')|signal_type|window_start). Added guardrail to reject future dates.

2025-04-30 — Mei Lin: Added unit tests for (a) UTC window boundaries (b) rerun idempotency (MERGE updates data_freshness_ts but does not duplicate) (c) late-arrival inclusion when events show up on day+2 (d) workspace_id null handling. Pushing PR shortly.
2025-05-01 — Priya Natarajan: Please add metrics hooks now (rows_written, lag) since oncall will need it once we start the pilot. Even basic StatsD counters are fine.

2025-05-02 — Mei Lin: Metrics added. Ran a backfill for last 30 days in staging; row counts match expectations from Ben’s pilot analysis sheet within 1–2% (difference is docs export lag). Marking ready for review.
updates: 2025-04-28 — Added rolling recompute + backfill parameters; switched MERGE key to dedupe_key to handle NULL workspace_id cleanly.
2025-05-02 — Added metrics hooks per Priya; ready for review.
2025-05-03 — Status → Done after merge + staging validation.
